title.narrative: Leveraging Digital Ecosystems for Increased MSMEs’ Productivity in Ghana

description.narrative: The Joint Programme aims to catalyze transformative change within youth and women-led micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), fostering their flourishing within a more inclusive digital ecosystem. This initiative empowers these enterprises to expand their operations, enhance productivity, and thrive in todays digital economy. The JP will contribute to Ghana’s Digital Transformation Journey with better policy and regulatory frameworks, digital infrastructure, and digital innovation. The catalytic effect will be set in motion through the identification of national priorities for the sustainable and inclusive development of e-commerce by the GoG and its use of a variety of tools to encourage ecosystem building and support businesses in meeting those priorities. It will benefit all MSMEs in-country, who will eventually enjoy easier access to capital, relevant skills, and market opportunities. The programme is expected to directly benefit 25,000 MSMEs with enhanced digital capacities, improved access to market, and improved access to financial services. It aims to leverage significant funding, with $600,000 co-funded within the JP budget and an additional $13,600,000 co-financed alongside the JP. This represents a substantial financial leverage, illustrating the programmes capacity to mobilize additional resources towards achieving its objectives and maximizing the impact of its interventions on Ghanas digital transformation journey. Aligned with Ghanas national development priorities and digital transformation objectives, and rooted in the UNSDCF 2023-2025 focus areas, the Joint Joint Programme leverages the expertise of participating PUNOs (UNCDF, UNDP, UNCTAD) to support state institutions and policy makers as well as private sector to equip thousands of MSMEs with:? conducive e-commerce environment? digital Gateway as a one stop shop for MSMEs? digital skills to navigate business and finance.? Relevant and accessible digital financial services
